description: A follow-up turn after a first reply that held only questions. The answers unblock the first requirements: each is marked (new), the FR sequence starts at 001, the answered questions are not asked again, and a new question continues the Q sequence after Q-005.

must_match.why: the FR sequence starts at 001, and a first-written requirement in a follow-up reply is marked (new)

must_match.pattern: ^FR-\d+ \(new\): (While [^\n]*, when|When) (a|the) member[^\n]* scans a book at the kiosk, the loan service shall record
^FR-\d+ \(new\): [^\n]*5 books on loan[^\n]*the loan service shall reject the loan and display "Loan limit reached"
must_match.why: Q-002 unblocks the limit requirement, with the user's response and text

must_not_match.why: every requirement in a follow-up reply is marked (new) or (changed)
answered questions are closed, not asked again, and a new question takes the next free ID
up to leaves the boundary open: the answer to Q-002 fixed it
